notes.1a: Very few candidates answered this part of the question as required with many making entries for all of the operating activities.
notes.1b: Most candidates did prepare the statement in accordance with IAS7 but there are still some candidates who continue to use the ‘old’ format. Generally the statement was prepared to an acceptable standard with entries being placed in the correct sections but relatively few candidates correctly reconciled the opening and closing bank balances at the end of the statement.
notes.1c: Most candidates answered this part well using the layout of the given extracted note.
notes.2a: The realisation account was well prepared by most candidates with the correct split being calculated.
notes.2b: The bank account, however, was less well prepared with many candidates incorrectly splitting the balance in the profit sharing ratio and seemingly being unaware of the relationship between the capital accounts and the bank account.
notes.2c: Most candidates made the correct entries to the capital accounts. A few were not able to deal correctly with the debit balance on Fonzie’s account.
notes.2d: Most candidates knew the reasons why a partnership may be dissolved.
notes.3a: Most candidates were able to correctly calculate the contribution although some marks were lost by candidates apparently not reading the question which clearly asked for both unit and total contribution.
notes.3b: Most candidates were able to make this calculation correctly. �PAGE�22
notes.3c: Many candidates did not perform well on this part. Some candidates did show a good understanding and obtained full marks but many are still giving answers in non-monetary denominations and do not understand the inter-relationship between the variances.
notes.3d: Most candidates scored reasonable marks by using their own variances correctly.
notes.3e: Candidates generally calculated the difference between contribution from parts (a) and (d). The question asked for the change in contribution due to the change in supplier and very few candidates addressed this.
notes.3f: The majority of candidates made a good attempt on this part but there were also some answers which did not focus on the question as set. �PAGE�23
notes.key_messages: Candidates should prepare fully across all areas of the syllabus when attempting this paper.
notes.general_comments:
Overall performance was reasonable with some very good scripts. An improvement was noted for the
costing question at this diet with greater understanding of the topic now being shown by more candidates.
The non-computational parts were also answered to a higher standard than previous sessions.
There was no evidence of time pressure and nearly all candidates answered the three questions fully.
